description: One dynaset Edit/Update of Mm.M of row 4, from 12000 characters to 1000 characters. Asks how the old long-value space and the row's reference change, and what happens to the neighbouring values on the same pages. Mm: eight rows (ID, Memo M): row 1 Null; rows 2, 6, 7 and 8 with 1000 characters of U+20AC (2000 UTF-16 bytes each); row 3 with 3000; row 4 with 12000; row 5 with the 20 ASCII characters 'twenty chars of text'. Typed lengths and FieldSize are read back. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
